title: ToolResultContent
description: The content of one tool result as the model receives it, for every tool, the SDR tools included (ADR-0030). The harness writes it; the context wraps it as untrusted.

oneOf.description: The tool ran and returned a result.

result.description: The result, as the tool's result schema describes it.

evidence_ids.description: Evidence recorded for this result. A design change cites these as the source of a measured value.

oneOf.description: The call failed: the arguments were invalid, or the tool reported an error, timed out or was cancelled.
The call was not allowed, so the tool did not run.
